allow_park.description: Allows pHelmIvP to enter PARK mode when override/all-stop handling requests it. If false, the helm may stay in DRIVE even when a parking-style override is active.

app_logging.description: Enables AppCastingMOOSApp logging for pHelmIvP. The value may be true or a logging target/file depending on the appcasting logging support.

bhv_dir_not_found_ok.description: Allows startup to continue when an ivp_behavior_dir entry cannot be found. This is useful when mission files are shared across machines where optional behavior-library paths may not exist.

contact_max_age.description: Sets how long contact information remains usable before pHelmIvP treats the contact as stale and removes related contact behavior state. Values are accepted in the range 10 to 1800 seconds.

goals_mandatory.description: Requires at least one non-constraint active goal behavior before the helm will produce normal decisions. When true, pHelmIvP warns or withholds action if only constraints are active.

helm_prefix.description: Sets a prefix added to selected helm status or decision variables posted by pHelmIvP. Use this when a mission needs helm output variables to be namespaced.

hold_on_app.description: Names one MOOS app that must appear in DB_CLIENTS before pHelmIvP considers its startup hold satisfied. This delays helm-start messages until required support apps are connected.

hold_on_apps.description: Names a comma-separated list of MOOS apps that must appear in DB_CLIENTS before pHelmIvP releases its startup hold. Each app name must be non-empty, unique, and contain no whitespace.

ivp_behavior_dir.description: Adds a directory searched for IvP behavior libraries referenced by the helm behavior file. Multiple ivp_behavior_dir lines may be used to add multiple search paths.

kcache.description: Controls behavior-set caching in pHelmIvP. This is an advanced/debug setting for how the helm caches behavior-related information rather than an ordinary mission tuning knob.

max_appcast_events.description: Limits how many appcast events pHelmIvP retains for reporting. This affects diagnostic history in appcast output, not helm decision logic.

nav_grace.description: Sets how many seconds old ownship navigation data may be before pHelmIvP treats it as stale. If NAV_* data exceeds this age, the helm can warn or withhold decisions that require current navigation.

node_skew.description: Declares the expected clock skew for a named external vehicle or node, using the form vehicle_name,seconds. pHelmIvP uses this when checking timestamps from external communities.

ok_skew.description: Sets the maximum acceptable timestamp skew, in seconds, before pHelmIvP treats external node timing as a problem. The special value any disables skew enforcement.

other_override_var.description: Names an additional MOOS variable that pHelmIvP treats as a manual/autonomy override input. This provides an alternative to the standard MOOS_MANUAL_OVERRIDE directive.

park_on_allstop.description: Requests that pHelmIvP enter PARK when an all-stop condition is active. This only has practical effect when parking/override handling is allowed.

pmgen.description: Configures the platform-model generator used by pHelmIvP for platform-aware helm calculations. The value is passed directly to the platform model generator, so it should be a generator parameter string rather than a free-form label.

start_engaged.description: Starts pHelmIvP with helm control already engaged instead of waiting for an engagement command. This is equivalent to setting the helm's initial control state true.

start_in_drive.description: Starts pHelmIvP in DRIVE/control mode rather than PARK/standby. The parser also accepts the legacy spelling start_indrive.

term_report_interval.description: Sets the interval between terminal status reports from pHelmIvP. Use this to reduce or increase how often helm status is printed to the terminal.

alert.description: Defines one contact-alert rule. Alert entries may set the posted flag, alert range, CPA range, display colors, and match/ignore filters; multiple lines with the same alert id combine into one alert definition.

alert_range_color.description: Sets the display color for the VIEW_CIRCLE used to render an alert range. This is normally used with display_radii so the configured alert radius is visible in a viewer.

alert_verbose.description: Enables verbose debugging output for contact-alert evaluation. This is useful when tuning alert logic and filters, but it can make the MOOSDB output noisier.

app_logging.description: Enables AppCastingMOOSApp logging for pBasicContactMgr. This records app-level diagnostics and is separate from contact alert or range-report postings.

contact_local_coords.description: Controls whether local x/y coordinates in incoming node reports are filled from latitude/longitude. Legal modes include verbatim, lazy_lat_lon, and force_lat_lon; verbatim leaves incoming reports unchanged.

contact_max_age.description: Sets how many seconds may pass without a fresh contact report before the contact is dropped from the active contact list. This bounds stale contact state in the manager.

contact_max_age_history.description: Sets how long a retired contact remains in contact-manager memory and retired-contact postings after it leaves the active list. This guards against unbounded retired-contact history.

contacts_recap_interval.description: Sets the minimum time, in seconds, between CONTACTS_RECAP postings. Increase this or turn recap posting off when recap output is too verbose for logging.

cpa_range_color.description: Sets the display color for the VIEW_CIRCLE used to render a CPA range. This is normally used with display_radii so the configured closest-point-of-approach radius is visible in a viewer.

decay.description: Controls extrapolation of stale contact reports as start,end seconds. Before the start time the last reported speed/heading are used, between start and end the speed decays toward zero, and 0,0 disables extrapolation.

default_alert_range.description: Sets the default alert range, in meters, used by alert rules that do not specify their own alert_range. Contacts inside this range can trigger the alert posting.

default_alert_range_color.description: Sets the default display color for alert range circles when an alert rule does not provide its own color. The source example uses gray65.

default_cpa_range.description: Sets the default CPA range, in meters, used by alert rules that do not specify their own cpa_range. A contact can trigger when its closest point of approach falls inside this range.

default_cpa_range_color.description: Sets the default display color for CPA range circles when an alert rule does not provide its own color. The source example uses gray35.

display_radii.description: Enables posting visual range circles for configured alert and CPA radii. This affects viewer output and does not change alert triggering.

display_radii_id.description: Selects which configured alert id should have its alert/CPA radii rendered when display_radii is enabled. This matters when multiple alert definitions are present.

eval_range_far.description: Sets the far threshold used when evaluating the closest approach of contacts. Contacts whose closest range falls inside this threshold are classified as a near encounter in summary metrics.

eval_range_near.description: Sets the near threshold used when evaluating closest approach of contacts. Contacts whose closest range falls inside this tighter threshold are classified as a very near encounter.

ignore_group.description: Adds a contact group to the global ignore filter. Contacts in ignored groups are excluded from contact-manager alert/range processing unless another rule overrides the filtering.

ignore_region.description: Adds a polygon region where contacts are ignored by the global filter. Use this to suppress alerts for contacts inside a known safe or irrelevant operating area.

ignore_type.description: Adds a contact type to the global ignore filter. Contacts reporting one of these types are excluded from contact-manager alert/range processing.

match_group.description: Adds a contact group to the global match filter. When match filters are configured, contacts must match the accepted group criteria to be processed.

match_region.description: Adds a polygon region that contacts must match to pass the global filter. Contacts outside the matched region are ignored for contact-manager processing.

match_type.description: Adds a contact type to the global match filter. When configured, only contacts with accepted types pass this part of contact-manager filtering.

max_appcast_events.description: Limits how many appcast events pBasicContactMgr retains for diagnostic reporting. This affects appcast history, not contact alert decisions.

max_retired_history.description: Limits how many retired contacts remain in the CONTACTS_RETIRED history. Values are clamped to the supported history range.

post_closest_range.description: Posts the range to the closest current contact, rounded to the nearest meter. This is a reporting option and does not affect alert logic.

range_report_timeout.description: Sets how long range-report data remains fresh before it is removed from range reports. This prevents stale contact ranges from lingering in posted summaries.

reject_range.description: Sets a range, in meters, beyond which new contacts are rejected and existing contacts may be dropped. This is a guard against tracking unbounded distant contacts.

strict_ignore.description: Controls how strictly group/type ignore filters treat contacts that omit those fields. When true, missing group or type information can cause a contact to be rejected by an ignore filter.

able_flag.description: Posts a MOOS variable-value flag whenever a contact is disabled or re-enabled. Use this for mission logic that needs to react to any contact availability transition.

alert.description: Defines one contact-alert rule. Alert entries may set the posted flag, alert range, CPA range, visual display options, early-warning behavior, and match/ignore filters; multiple lines with the same id combine into one alert definition.

alert_range_color.description: Sets the default display color for alert range circles. This color is used when an alert rule does not specify its own alert range color.

alert_verbose.description: Enables verbose debugging output for contact-alert evaluation. This is useful while tuning alert logic, but it can add noisy ALERT_VERBOSE output.

app_logging.description: Enables AppCastingMOOSApp logging for pContactMgrV20. This records app-level diagnostics and is separate from contact alert, range, and recap postings.

cease_warning_flag.description: Posts a MOOS variable-value flag when a previously triggered early warning is no longer relevant. This pairs with early_warning_flag for warning lifecycle reporting.

contact_local_coords.description: Controls whether local x/y coordinates in incoming node reports are filled from latitude/longitude. Legal modes include verbatim, lazy_lat_lon, and force_lat_lon; verbatim leaves incoming reports unchanged.

contact_max_age.description: Sets how many seconds may pass without a fresh contact report before the contact is retired and dropped from the active contact list. The current pContactMgrV20 source initializes this to 60 seconds.

cpa_range_color.description: Sets the default display color for CPA range circles. This color is used when an alert rule does not specify its own CPA range color.

decay.description: Controls extrapolation of stale contact reports as start,end seconds. Before the start time the last reported speed/heading are used, between start and end the speed decays toward zero, and 0,0 disables extrapolation.

disable_var.description: Names the MOOS variable pContactMgrV20 listens to for contact-disable requests. If it is unset, external disable requests are not accepted.

disable_flag.description: Posts a MOOS variable-value flag whenever a contact is disabled. Use this for mission logic or logging that needs to observe disable events.

display_radii.description: Enables posting visual range circles for configured alert and CPA radii. This affects viewer output and does not change alert triggering.

display_radii_id.description: Selects which configured alert id should have its alert/CPA radii rendered when display_radii is enabled. This matters when multiple alert definitions are present.

early_warning_flag.description: Posts a MOOS variable-value flag when an early warning is triggered before the full contact alert condition. Use this to react before the alert range or CPA condition is reached.

early_warning_radii.description: Enables posting a visual range circle for the early-warning distance. This is a viewer aid for warning geometry and does not itself trigger alerts.

early_warning_time.description: Sets how many seconds before the predicted contact alert an early-warning event should be posted. A negative value leaves early warnings disabled.

enable_var.description: Names the MOOS variable pContactMgrV20 listens to for contact-enable requests. If it is unset, external enable requests are not accepted.

enable_flag.description: Posts a MOOS variable-value flag whenever a contact is enabled. Use this for mission logic or logging that needs to observe re-enable events.

eval_range_far.description: Sets the far threshold used when evaluating closest approach of contacts. Contacts whose closest range falls inside this threshold are counted as near encounters in summary metrics.

eval_range_near.description: Sets the near threshold used when evaluating closest approach of contacts. Contacts whose closest range falls inside this tighter threshold are counted as very near encounters.

ewarn_radii_color.description: Sets the display color for the early-warning range circle. This affects viewer output when early_warning_radii is enabled.

hold_alerts_for_helm.description: Holds or delays contact-alert postings until pHelmIvP is ready to receive them. This prevents contact alerts from being sent before the helm is active.

ignore_group.description: Adds one or more contact groups to the global ignore filter. Contacts in ignored groups are excluded from contact-manager alert/range processing.

ignore_name.description: Adds one or more contact names to the global ignore filter. Contacts with ignored names are excluded from contact-manager alert/range processing.

ignore_region.description: Adds a polygon region where contacts are ignored by the global filter. Use this to suppress alerts for contacts inside a known safe or irrelevant operating area.

ignore_type.description: Adds one or more contact types to the global ignore filter. Contacts reporting ignored types are excluded from contact-manager alert/range processing.

match_group.description: Adds one or more contact groups to the global match filter. When match filters are configured, contacts must match the accepted group criteria to be processed.

match_name.description: Adds one or more contact names to the global match filter. When configured, only contacts with accepted names pass this part of filtering.

match_region.description: Adds a polygon region that contacts must match to pass the global filter. Contacts outside the matched region are ignored for contact-manager processing.

match_type.description: Adds one or more contact types to the global match filter. When configured, only contacts with accepted types pass this part of filtering.

max_appcast_events.description: Limits how many appcast events pContactMgrV20 retains for diagnostic reporting. This affects appcast history, not contact alert decisions.

max_contacts.description: Sets the maximum number of contacts pContactMgrV20 tracks before removing or retiring contacts to stay within the limit. This is a memory and scalability guard.

max_retired_hist.description: Limits how many retired contacts are listed in CONTACTS_RETIRED history. Legal values are clamped to the supported range, and retired contacts are still reported at least once.

max_retired_history.description: Limits how many retired contacts remain in the CONTACTS_RETIRED history. Values are clamped to the supported history range, and retired contacts are still reported at least once.

ownship_group.description: Sets the group label assigned to ownship for contact-manager filtering and alert context. This lets global match/ignore logic distinguish ownship metadata from contact metadata.

ownship_type.description: Sets the type label assigned to ownship for contact-manager filtering and alert context. This lets global match/ignore logic distinguish ownship metadata from contact metadata.

post_all_ranges.description: Posts ordered range reports for all current contacts. This is a reporting option and can increase MOOSDB traffic when many contacts are present.

post_closest_range.description: Posts the range to the closest current contact, rounded to the nearest meter. This is a reporting option and does not affect alert logic.

post_closest_relbng.description: Posts the relative bearing to the closest current contact along with closest-contact reporting. This is a reporting option and does not affect alert logic.

range_report_maxsize.description: Limits how many contact range reports are retained and posted in range-report summaries. This keeps range-report output bounded when many contacts are present.

range_report_timeout.description: Sets how long range-report data remains fresh before it is removed from range reports. This prevents stale contact ranges from lingering in posted summaries.

recap_interval.description: Sets the minimum time, in seconds, between CONTACTS_RECAP postings. Use off to suppress recap posting when it is too verbose for logging.

reject_range.description: Sets a range, in meters, beyond which new contacts are ignored and existing contacts may be dropped. This is a guard against tracking unbounded distant contacts.

strict_ignore.description: Controls how strictly group/type ignore filters treat contacts that omit those fields. When true, missing group or type information can cause a contact to be rejected by an ignore filter.

qblink.description: Names the MOOS variable iBlinkStick subscribes to for LED blink/color commands. Incoming mail on this variable is translated into qblink.sh commands for the BlinkStick device.

app_logging.description: Enables AppCastingMOOSApp logging for iSay. This records app-level diagnostics and is separate from the speech/audio output itself.

max_appcast_events.description: Limits how many appcast events iSay retains in its appcast report history. This affects diagnostic reporting, not which utterances are spoken.

volume.description: Sets the default playback volume for utterances and audio files. Named values include mute, vsoft, soft, normal, loud, and vloud; numeric values are clipped to the supported range.

audio_dir.description: Adds a directory to the search path used when an utterance request names an audio file. Multiple audio_dir lines may be used; iSay checks these directories when resolving file= requests.

default_rate.description: Sets the default speech rate used when an incoming SAY_MOOS utterance does not specify its own rate. The value is passed to the speech backend as the rate for spoken text.

default_voice.description: Sets the voice used for spoken utterances when a SAY_MOOS request omits the voice field. Available voice names depend on the platform speech backend.

interval_policy.description: Controls whether the minimum interval between utterances is measured from the start or the end of the previous utterance. Supported values are from_start and from_end.

os_mode.description: Selects which operating-system speech backend iSay should use for speech and audio playback. Supported values are osx, linux, and both.

min_utter_interval.description: Sets the minimum number of seconds between queued utterances. iSay will not start the next utterance until this interval permits it.

app_logging.description: Enables AppCastingMOOSApp logging for pDeadManPost. This records app-level diagnostics and is separate from the heartbeat/deadflag logic.

max_appcast_events.description: Limits how many appcast events pDeadManPost retains in its report history. This affects diagnostic reporting, not deadflag posting behavior.

heartbeat_var.description: Names the MOOS variable treated as the heartbeat. Each received posting resets the missing-heartbeat timer.

active_at_start.description: Starts the heartbeat timer immediately when pDeadManPost launches. If false, the timer does not become active until the first heartbeat is received.

deadflag.description: Defines one MOOS variable-value pair posted when the heartbeat has been missing longer than max_noheart.

max_noheart.description: Sets how many seconds a heartbeat may be absent before pDeadManPost posts the deadflags.

post_policy.description: Controls how deadflags are posted after the heartbeat fails. Supported policies are once, repeat, and reset.

flip:1.description: Defines one pEchoVar flip rule that extracts or transforms fields from a source MOOS variable and posts the result to a destination variable. Numbered flip blocks group fields such as source_variable, dest_variable, separators, filters, and components.

app_logging.description: Enables AppCastingMOOSApp logging for pEchoVar. This records app-level diagnostics and is separate from echo/flip message forwarding.

flip:2.description: Defines a second pEchoVar flip rule. Use additional numbered flip entries when multiple independent source-to-destination field transformations are needed.

max_appcast_events.description: Limits how many appcast events pEchoVar retains in its report history. This affects diagnostic reporting, not echo or flip forwarding.

echo.description: Maps one source MOOS variable to another destination variable so incoming mail on the source is re-posted under the destination name.

echo_latest_only.description: When true, pEchoVar posts only the most recent received value for an echoed variable on each iteration instead of replaying every queued message.

condition.description: Adds a logic condition that must be true before echo and flip publications are made. When false, messages may be held depending on hold_messages.

flip.description: Defines a pEchoVar flip rule that extracts or transforms components from a source variable and posts the result to a destination variable.

hold_messages.description: When true, pEchoVar retains incoming messages received while conditions are false and processes them once conditions become true.

app_logging.description: Enables AppCastingMOOSApp logging for pHostInfo. This records app-level diagnostics and is separate from the host/interface report values.

prefer_interface.description: Selects the preferred network interface when multiple valid IP addresses are available. Supported interface selectors include wlan0, wifi, eth0, eth1, usb0, usb1, and usb2.

prefer_inerface.description: Documentation typo for prefer_interface. The intended setting selects the preferred network interface when multiple valid IP addresses are available.
prefer_inerface.reviewSource: MOOS-IvP app_phostinfo.pdf: Listing 2.1 typo; moos-ivp/ivp/src/pHostInfo/HostInfo_Info.cpp:103 documents prefer_interface

temp_file_dir.description: Sets the directory pHostInfo uses for temporary files while discovering host address information. Use a directory path, not an output filename.

default_hostip.description: Sets the fallback IP address pHostInfo posts when it cannot determine an address from the machine interfaces.

default_hostip_force.description: Forces pHostInfo to use the configured fallback IP address instead of an auto-discovered network-interface address. This is mainly useful for debugging or controlled simulations.

button_*.description: Defines one on-screen command button and the MOOS variable-value posts triggered when it is clicked. The value begins with the button label, followed by one or more # separated MOOS posts.

*_viewable_all.description: Toggles rendering of all visual objects in this display category. Setting it false suppresses the objects themselves without changing whether the underlying MOOS mail is received.

*_viewable_labels.description: Toggles rendering of labels for visual objects in this display category. Setting it false hides labels while leaving the objects themselves controlled by the corresponding viewable setting.

*_font_size.description: Sets the font size for the named pMarineViewer pane. Supported values are xsmall, small, medium, large, and xlarge.

action.description: Adds a variable-value command to the Action pull-down menu. The value may include a menu key and multiple # separated MOOS posts.

action+.description: Adds an Action-menu command like action, while also requesting a visual separator before following menu items. Use it to group related operator commands.

appcast_height.description: Legacy spelling for infocast_height. It sets the relative height of the lower appcast/realmcast pane in the pMarineViewer infocast area.

appcast_width.description: Legacy spelling for infocast_width. It sets the width of the appcast/realmcast pane area as a percentage of the pMarineViewer window width.

back_shade.description: Sets the grayscale shade of the background when no TIFF image is being shown. Values range from 0 for black to 1 for white.

bearing_lines.description: Controls whether bearing-line visualization messages are rendered. This is a display setting for viewer artifacts, not contact or navigation logic.

bearing_lines_viewable.description: Toggles rendering of bearing-line visual artifacts. Setting it false suppresses bearing lines while leaving other viewer objects unaffected.

center_view.description: Sets automatic panning behavior relative to vehicles. Use active to keep the active vehicle centered, average to center the average position of vehicles, or leave unset for normal pan settings.

content_mode.description: Selects the startup content shown in the infocast panes. Supported modes include appcast and realmcast.

drop_point_coords.description: Controls how drop-point labels show coordinates. Supported values include as-dropped, lat-lon, and local-grid.

drop_point_vertex_size.description: Sets the point size used to render drop points. Legal values are integer sizes in the supported viewer range.

extrap_policy.description: Chooses how pMarineViewer extrapolates stale node reports for display. This affects visual display of vehicle positions when reports are delayed.

full_screen.description: Starts pMarineViewer in full-screen geo-display mode, hiding appcast/realmcast panes and bottom fields. This is a display layout setting.

grid_opaqueness.description: Sets the opacity of rendered grid objects. Values range from 0 for transparent to 1 for fully opaque.

grid_viewable_opaqueness.description: Sets the opacity of rendered grid objects. Values range from 0 for transparent to 1 for fully opaque.

hash_delta.description: Sets the spacing, in meters, between background hash/grid lines. Common supported spacings include 50, 100, 200, 500, and 1000.

hash_shade.description: Sets the grayscale shade used for hash marks. Values range from 0 for black to 1 for white.

infocast_height.description: Sets the height of the lower appcast/realmcast pane as a percentage of the pMarineViewer window. Supported values are stepped from 30 through 90.

infocast_viewable.description: Controls whether the infocast pane set is visible on the left side of the viewer. This affects layout only.

infocast_width.description: Sets the width of the appcast/realmcast pane area as a percentage of the pMarineViewer window width. Supported values are stepped from 20 through 70.

left_context.description: Defines a left-click context menu command that posts a MOOS variable-value pair using mouse-position macros such as $(XPOS), $(YPOS), $(LAT), and $(LON).

log_the_file.description: Requests that pLogger copy a configured file into the mission log set. This is used to preserve viewer-related files alongside mission logs.

log_the_image.description: Requests that pLogger copy the active background image and related info file into the mission log set. This helps alogview later reproduce the viewer background.

marker.description: Defines a static marker using the same comma-separated field syntax as VIEW_MARKER messages. A marker needs a type and a position, with optional label, color, width, and message fields.

marker_scale.description: Applies a global scale factor to marker rendering. This changes visual marker size without changing marker positions.

mission_hash_display.description: Controls whether mission-hash information is displayed in pMarineViewer. Use this with mission_hash_var when mission hashes are part of the operator display.

mission_hash_var.description: Names the MOOS variable containing the mission hash to display in pMarineViewer.

oparea.description: Defines the operation-area boundary for optional rendering. The value is a polygon specification in the same style used by other MOOS-IvP geometry objects.
oparea.reviewSource: MOOS-IvP app_pmviewer.pdf: datum and oparea rendering

op_vertex.description: Adds one vertex to the operation-area polygon rendered by pMarineViewer. Use repeated op_vertex lines to build the displayed operation-area boundary.

realmcast_channel.description: Selects the realmcast channel or cluster shown in the pMarineViewer realmcast pane. This controls displayed realmcast content, not publication by pRealm itself.

refresh_mode.description: Controls how pMarineViewer requests appcasts from apps. Supported modes include paused, events, and streaming.

right_context.description: Defines a right-click context menu command that posts a MOOS variable-value pair using mouse-position macros such as $(XPOS), $(YPOS), $(LAT), and $(LON).

scope.description: Registers one or more MOOS variables for display in the pMarineViewer scope field and Scope menu. Multiple scope lines may be used.

stale_remove_thresh.description: Sets how long after a vehicle becomes stale pMarineViewer waits before removing it from rendering. This affects display cleanup for vehicles that stop reporting.

stale_report_thresh.description: Sets how many seconds without a node report cause a vehicle to be considered stale in pMarineViewer. This affects stale display state, not contact management.

tiff_file.description: Adds a TIFF background image for the viewer. Current pMarineViewer versions allow multiple tiff_file lines and cycle among them.

tiff_file_b.description: Deprecated second TIFF background image parameter. Prefer multiple tiff_file lines in current pMarineViewer versions.

tiff_type.description: Deprecated parameter no longer supported after Release 22.8.x. Use multiple tiff_file entries and the viewer's image toggle behavior instead.

trails_point_size.description: Sets the point size used when rendering vehicle trail points. Legal values are integer sizes in the supported viewer range.

vehicles_shape_scale.description: Applies a scale factor to rendered vehicle shapes. This changes visual vehicle size without changing reported vehicle state.

view_center.description: Sets the initial center of the viewer image in local x,y coordinates. This controls the startup pan origin.

watch_cluster.description: Defines a realmcast watch cluster so selected variables can be monitored across vehicles in a table. The value names the cluster and its scoped variables.

cmd.description: Defines one command-button post for pMarineViewer command GUI support, with fields such as label, target variable, and string or numeric value.

node_report_unc.description: Enables handling and rendering of NODE_REPORT_UNC uncertainty reports in addition to ordinary node reports.

rows.description: Configures the background grid row orientation and spacing used by pMarineViewer.

show_title_ip.description: Controls whether the viewer title bar includes IP address information.

show_title_mhash.description: Controls whether the viewer title bar includes the mission hash.

show_title_user.description: Controls whether the viewer title bar includes the user name.

vehicle_shape_scale.description: Scales the rendered vehicle shape size in the pMarineViewer display.

allow_color_change.description: Allows incoming NODE_COLOR_CHANGE mail to update the color field included in generated node reports. When false, runtime color-change requests are ignored.

alt_nav_group.description: Sets the group field used in alternate navigation node reports. If omitted, the alternate report uses the baseline node report group.

alt_nav_name.description: Sets the node name used for alternate navigation node reports. A common value is _GT for ground-truth reports.

alt_nav_prefix.description: Sets the NAV_* prefix used as the source for alternate navigation reports. For example, NAV_GT reads NAV_GT_X, NAV_GT_Y, and related variables.

app_logging.description: Enables AppCastingMOOSApp logging for pNodeReporter. This records app-level diagnostics and is separate from NODE_REPORT_LOCAL or PLATFORM_REPORT_LOCAL output.

blackout_interval.description: Sets the minimum time, in seconds, between node report postings when simulating sparse or dropped reports. A zero value disables this blackout spacing.

blackout_variance.description: Adds uniformly random variation to the blackout interval when sparse report posting is enabled. The value is a non-negative duration in seconds.

coord_policy_global.description: When true, node reports publish only latitude/longitude coordinates and omit local x/y coordinates. The crossfill policy controls how lat/lon values are obtained.

cross_fill_policy.description: Controls how pNodeReporter fills missing local x/y coordinates from lat/lon or missing lat/lon coordinates from local x/y. Supported policies include literal, fill-empty, use-latest, and global.

crossfill_policy.description: Controls how pNodeReporter fills missing local x/y coordinates from lat/lon or missing lat/lon coordinates from local x/y. Supported policies include literal, fill-empty, use-latest, and global.

extrap_enabled.description: Enables sparse node-report posting based on extrapolation. When enabled, reports may be held back until movement, heading change, or max-gap thresholds require a fresh report.

extrap_hdg_thresh.description: Sets the heading-change threshold, in degrees, that forces a new node report when extrapolated reporting is enabled.

extrap_hdg_thres.description: Legacy or misspelled spelling of extrap_hdg_thresh. It sets the heading-change threshold, in degrees, that forces a new node report when extrapolated reporting is enabled.

extrap_max_gap.description: Sets the maximum time, in seconds, that may pass without posting a node report when extrapolated reporting is enabled.

extrap_pos_thresh.description: Sets the position-change threshold, in meters, that forces a new node report when extrapolated reporting is enabled.

group.description: Sets the group label included in generated node reports. This is a source-level alias for platform_group.

hdg_error.description: Adds a test offset, in degrees, to the heading field in generated node reports. This is intended for testing downstream consumers with inconsistent heading/course data.

json_report.description: Controls JSON node-report publication. When true, the node report is published in JSON format; when set to another variable name, JSON is posted there while normal CSP output continues.

max_appcast_events.description: Limits how many appcast events pNodeReporter retains for diagnostic reporting. This does not affect NODE_REPORT or PLATFORM_REPORT content.

nav_grace_period.description: Sets the startup grace period, in seconds, before pNodeReporter warns about missing navigation inputs such as NAV_LAT or NAV_LONG. A negative value disables the grace limit.

nav_grace_periode.description: Misspelled source-discovered spelling of nav_grace_period. It sets the startup grace period before missing navigation inputs trigger warnings.

node_report_output.description: Names the MOOS variable used for the local node report output. The conventional default is NODE_REPORT_LOCAL.

nohelm_threshold.description: Sets how many seconds of quiet helm output are tolerated before pNodeReporter reports the helm as AWOL. This affects the helm-status fields in node reporting.

paused.description: Starts or places pNodeReporter in a paused state, suspending report publication while still allowing the app to run.

plat_report_input.description: Adds one MOOS variable to the optional platform report, with optional fields such as gap and alias. The platform report is posted only when configured inputs require an update.

plat_report_output.description: Names the MOOS variable used for optional platform-report output. The conventional default is PLATFORM_REPORT_LOCAL.

platform_aspect.description: Adds a static param=value rider field to generated node reports. If the same field is configured more than once, the later value replaces the earlier one.

platform_beam.description: Sets the reported platform beam, in meters, included in node reports.

platform_color.description: Sets the color hint included in node reports for viewers such as pMarineViewer and alogview.

platform_group.description: Sets the group label included in generated node reports. This is useful for team or fleet grouping in downstream viewers and contact tools.

platform_length.description: Sets the reported platform length, in meters, included in node reports. Some known platform types may imply a rough default length when no length is configured.

platform_transparency.description: Sets the transparency hint included in node reports for viewers. Values range from 0 for nearly transparent to 1 for fully opaque.

platform_type.description: Sets the reported platform type included in node reports, such as kayak, uuv, auv, ship, or glider.

platform_vsource.description: Sets the reported vehicle source field included in node reports. This is useful when node reports are derived from a particular sensor or tracking source.

report_cog.description: Adds calculated course-over-ground information to node reports. The value is computed from recent position changes rather than the raw heading field.

rider.description: Adds a dynamic rider field to node reports by subscribing to a MOOS variable and appending a formatted field to outgoing reports. Common fields include var, rfld, policy, and precision.

terse_reports.description: Omits selected less-essential fields such as YAW from node reports when true. Use this to reduce report size.

output.description: Defines an outbound pShare route for forwarding MOOS mail to another community or endpoint. The value is a route specification rather than a simple variable name.

incoming_var.description: Names the MOOS variable pXRelay listens to as the source side of the relay. Mail on this variable is republished on OUTGOING_VAR.

outgoing_var.description: Names the MOOS variable pXRelay posts as the destination side of the relay. This receives the values read from INCOMING_VAR.

buoyancy_rate.description: Sets the upward buoyancy-driven depth-change rate, in meters per second, applied when the vehicle has no opposing vertical control. Positive values make the simulated vehicle naturally rise toward the surface.

current_field.description: Loads a file describing a spatial current field for the simulator. When active, the current field contributes environmental drift to simulated vehicle motion.

current_field_active.description: Enables or disables use of the configured current field. This lets a mission keep the current-field file configured while toggling whether the simulator applies it.

default_water_depth.description: Sets the default local water depth, in meters, used for altitude calculations. A value of zero means no known water depth, so altitude is not reported from depth alone.

drift_vector.description: Sets the environmental drift as heading,magnitude. The simulator converts this vector into x/y drift components and applies it to vehicle motion.

drift_x.description: Sets the environmental drift component in the local x direction, in meters per second. This drift is added to simulated vehicle position updates.

drift_y.description: Sets the environmental drift component in the local y direction, in meters per second. This drift is added to simulated vehicle position updates.

dual_state.description: Enables dual-state simulator output mode, causing the simulator to publish both ordinary navigation state and a separate ground-truth state where supported.

max_acceleration.description: Limits the simulated acceleration rate in meters per second squared. A zero value disables acceleration limiting.

max_appcast_events.description: Limits how many appcast events uSimMarineV22 retains for diagnostic reporting. This affects appcast history, not simulated vehicle motion.

max_deceleration.description: Limits the simulated deceleration rate in meters per second squared. This caps how quickly commanded thrust changes can slow the vehicle.

max_depth_rate.description: Limits how quickly simulated depth can change, in meters per second. This cap applies to the vertical-motion model.

max_depth_rate_speed.description: Sets the vehicle speed at which the configured maximum depth-change rate is achievable. It shapes how speed affects vertical maneuvering authority.

max_rudder_degs_per_sec.description: Limits how quickly the simulated rudder command may change, in degrees per second. A zero value leaves rudder changes effectively unconstrained by this limiter.

max_trim_delay.description: Sets the maximum wait time, in seconds, for a trim request to complete before it is treated as delayed or failed. This is part of the buoyancy/trim handshake logic.

polar_plot.description: Defines or loads the sailing polar plot used by the wind model. The polar plot maps wind angle/speed context into sailing performance behavior.

post_navpos_summary.description: Enables posting a compact navigation-position summary from the simulator. This is additional reporting and does not change the simulated dynamics.

prefix.description: Sets the prefix used for navigation variables published by the simulator, such as PREFIX_X, PREFIX_Y, PREFIX_HEADING, and PREFIX_SPEED. The default source prefix is USM.

rotate_speed.description: Applies an external rotational drift rate, in degrees per second, to simulated heading updates. This is added to heading change independently of rudder-induced turning.

sim_pause.description: Starts or places the simulator in a paused state. While paused, simulated state advancement is suspended until unpaused.

start_depth.description: Sets the initial simulated vehicle depth in meters. This is part of the starting vehicle state.

start_heading.description: Sets the initial simulated vehicle heading in degrees. This is part of the starting vehicle state.

start_pos.description: Sets the starting vehicle position using a full position specification. This can initialize multiple state fields in one configuration line.

start_speed.description: Sets the initial simulated vehicle speed in meters per second. This is part of the starting vehicle state.

start_x.description: Sets the initial simulated vehicle x position in local coordinates. This is part of the starting vehicle state.

start_y.description: Sets the initial simulated vehicle y position in local coordinates. This is part of the starting vehicle state.

thrust_factor.description: Sets the simple linear thrust-to-speed conversion factor used when a thrust map is not active. Speed is calculated from thrust divided by this factor.

thrust_map.description: Defines a piecewise mapping between thrust commands and simulated speed. When provided, this map replaces the simple thrust_factor relationship.

thrust_reflect.description: Controls whether negative thrust mirrors positive thrust in the thrust-to-speed mapping. When true, reverse thrust is treated as the opposite of positive thrust.

trim_tolerance.description: Sets the tolerance used when deciding whether a trim request has reached its target. This is part of the buoyancy/trim control handshake.

turn_loss.description: Sets the speed-loss factor applied while the simulated vehicle is turning. Values are in the range 0 to 1, where larger values impose more speed loss at high rudder.

turn_rate.description: Sets the nominal vehicle turn-rate authority as a percentage scale from 0 to 100. The simulator clips the value to that range before applying rudder-induced heading changes.

turn_spd_map_full_rate.description: Sets the turn-rate percentage used at the full-speed point in the turn-speed map. This shapes how available turning authority changes with simulated speed.

turn_spd_map_full_speed.description: Sets the speed associated with the full-speed point in the turn-speed map. This pairs with turn_spd_map_full_rate to define speed-dependent turn authority.

turn_spd_map_null_rate.description: Sets the turn-rate percentage used at the null-speed point in the turn-speed map. This shapes how much turning authority exists near zero speed.

turn_spd_map_null_speed.description: Sets the speed associated with the null-speed point in the turn-speed map. This pairs with turn_spd_map_null_rate to define speed-dependent turn authority.

wind_conditions.description: Defines wind speed and direction for the simulator wind model. This is used with sailing/polar-plot simulation support.

wormhole.description: Defines one wormhole configuration component, such as the entry polygon, exit polygon, connection direction, id-change behavior, or delay. Multiple wormhole lines with the same tag combine into one wormhole definition.

cmd.description: Defines a command entry that uCommand can post to the MOOSDB. The value is a configured MOOS variable-value command, not a shell command.

poke.description: Defines a MOOS variable-value post for uPokeDB to send to the MOOSDB. Multiple poke entries may be used when several startup or scripted posts are needed.

halt_condition.description: Stops uQueryDB when the given MOOS logic condition evaluates true. Use this to make a query session terminate after a mission state or variable condition is reached.

halt_max_time.description: Stops uQueryDB after the configured maximum elapsed time even if the halt condition has not become true. This is a timeout for bounded query sessions.

max_time.description: Sets the maximum time uQueryDB should run before exiting. This is an alias-style timeout used to keep query runs finite.

wait.description: Waits this many seconds for queried variables to appear before uQueryDB exits with failure when an initial query is missing.

check_var.description: Adds a MOOS variable whose final value should be included in the optional query result report when uQueryDB exits successfully.

check_var_format.description: Selects the output format for check_var reports. Supported formats are esv, csv, wsv, and vo.

condition.description: Adds a pass condition; this is an alias for pass_condition. All pass conditions must be true for uQueryDB to return success.

pass_condition.description: Adds a logic condition that must be true for uQueryDB to return success. All configured pass conditions are evaluated together.

fail_condition.description: Adds a logic condition that causes uQueryDB to return failure if it becomes true. Any satisfied fail condition is enough to fail the query.

cmd.description: Defines a terminal-selectable cue that posts one MOOS variable-value pair, using the form cue --> variable --> value.

app_logging.description: Enables AppCastingMOOSApp logging for uTimerScript. This records app-level diagnostics and is separate from scripted MOOS posts.

forward_variable.description: Names the MOOS variable used to request that uTimerScript advance through scripted events. This provides an external control input for script progression.

max_appcast_events.description: Limits how many appcast events uTimerScript retains in its report history. This affects diagnostics, not the scheduled event list.

pause_variable.description: Names the MOOS variable used to pause or resume uTimerScript execution. This lets another app control whether scheduled posts are currently advancing.

randvar.description: Defines a random variable generator used by uTimerScript events, including fields such as variable name, minimum, maximum, and key timing. Generated values can then be used in scripted posts.

block_on.description: Blocks script execution until the named MOOS apps have appeared in DB_CLIENTS.

reset_max.description: Sets the maximum number of script resets allowed. Use a non-negative integer or nolimit.

upon_awake.description: Controls what happens when script conditions become true after being false. Supported values include n/a, reset, and restart.

app_logging.description: Enables AppCastingMOOSApp logging for uXMS. This records app-level diagnostics and is separate from the scoped MOOS mail display.

color_map.description: Associates a variable, source, or community pattern with a display color in uXMS output. Use this to make selected scoped entries visually distinct in the terminal view.

paused.description: Starts or keeps the uXMS display in a paused state when supported by the app's display loop. This affects live display updating, not whether uXMS receives MOOS mail.

source.description: Restricts displayed variables to mail from the named MOOS source app or apps.

wrap_data_len.description: Sets the line length used when uXMS wraps long variable values.

colormap.description: Associates a MOOS variable, source, or community substring with a terminal color in uXMS output.

content_mode.description: Selects which uXMS report view is shown at startup. Supported modes include scoping, history, procs, and help.

display_all.description: When true, uXMS shows all MOOSDB variables in scoping mode rather than only the configured watch variables.

display_aux_source.description: When true, uXMS shows non-empty auxiliary source information in the source column instead of the ordinary source app name.

display_community.description: Controls whether the Community column is shown in scoping and history reports.

display_history_var.description: Controls whether the variable name is shown on each row in history mode. Turning it off saves horizontal space when the history view is scoped to one variable.

display_source.description: Controls whether the Source column is shown in scoping and history reports.

display_time.description: Controls whether the Time column is shown in scoping and history reports.

display_virgins.description: Controls whether variables that have never been written, or have empty-string values, are shown in uXMS reports.

history_var.description: Names the single MOOS variable shown in uXMS history mode. If multiple history_var lines are provided, the last one is used.

refresh_mode.description: Controls when uXMS refreshes terminal output. Supported modes are events, streaming, and paused.

term_report_interval.description: Sets the minimum time, in seconds, between uXMS terminal report updates. Accepted values are clipped to the supported range.

trunc_data.description: Sets the maximum number of characters shown for long string values before uXMS truncates them and appends an ellipsis. A value of 0 disables truncation.

wrap_data.description: Controls whether long variable values are wrapped across multiple lines in uXMS output.

var.description: Adds one or more MOOS variables to the uXMS scoping watch list.

flag.description: Defines one MOOS variable-value post that pAutoPoke will publish once the required node count has been reached.

required_nodes.description: Sets how many nodes must be detected before pAutoPoke publishes its configured flags. A value of 0 allows the flags to be posted without waiting for node reports.

mission_form.description: Sets the mission-form name used when expanding MISSION_FORM macros in generated reports.

report_column.description: Defines one output column in the mission-evaluation report file.

report_line_format.description: Selects the separator format used between mission-evaluation report columns.

fail_condition.description: Adds a logic condition that causes the mission evaluation to fail if it is satisfied.

fail_flag.description: Defines one MOOS variable-value post made after pMissionEval determines that the mission did not pass.

lead_condition.description: Adds a logic condition that must become true before the associated pass/fail aspect is evaluated.

pass_condition.description: Adds a logic condition that must be true for the mission, or the current evaluation aspect, to pass.

pass_flag.description: Defines one MOOS variable-value post made after pMissionEval determines that the mission passed.

report_file.description: Names the file where pMissionEval writes the configured report columns and final mission result.

result_flag.description: Defines one MOOS variable-value post made once pMissionEval has determined the mission result, regardless of pass or fail.

pObstacleMgr.reviewSource: MOOS-IvP obstacle manager docs and moos-ivp/ivp/src/pObstacleMgr

ignore_range.description: Ignores incoming obstacle points farther than this range from ownship. A negative value disables range-based ignoring.

general_alert.description: Defines the default alert request posted by pObstacleMgr when obstacle conditions require a general alert.

given_obstacle.description: Supplies an obstacle polygon directly to pObstacleMgr, using the same polygon specification style used in GIVEN_OBSTACLE mail.

msg_max_hist.description: Sets how many recent messages pRealm keeps per variable for string-message history display.

scope_set.description: Defines a named set of MOOS variables or realmcast fields to include in pRealm reporting.

relcast_interval.description: Sets the minimum time, in seconds, between generated REALMCAST reports. Values are clipped to the supported range.

summary_interval.description: Sets the time, in seconds, between automatic REALMCAST_CHANNELS summary postings. The local source initializes this to 5 seconds.

wrap_length.description: Sets the number of characters per line when pRealm wraps long variable values in realmcast output.

trunc_length.description: Sets the maximum value-field length used when pRealm truncates long realmcast output values.

grid_config.description: Defines the search grid geometry and labeling used by pSearchGrid.

default_vsource.description: Sets the default vehicle source included in spoofed node reports when a spoof request does not provide vsource.

spoof.description: Defines one spoofed node-report request. Position is required; omitted optional fields use the configured default_* values or an auto-generated contact name.

beacon.description: Defines one simulated beacon, including its position, label, and optional per-beacon range/reporting properties.

default.description: Sets a default beacon property applied when an individual beacon does not provide that property.

default_beacon_freq.description: Sets the default unsolicited report interval for beacons. The value may be never, a fixed number of seconds, or a random range such as 60:120.

default_beacon_shape.description: Sets the default marker shape used when rendering beacons.

ping_wait.description: Sets the mandatory wait time, in seconds, between successive vehicle pings to the beacon range sensor.

rn_algorithm.description: Selects the random-noise algorithm applied to simulated beacon range measurements, such as uniform noise with a configured percentage.

default_beacon_push_dist.description: Sets the default distance from a beacon within which its unsolicited or solicited range report can be received.

default_beacon_pull_dist.description: Sets the default distance a vehicle-side ping can reach when querying beacons.

default_beacon_width.description: Sets the default rendered marker width for beacons.

default_beacon_color.description: Sets the default marker color used when rendering beacons.

default_beacon_report_range.description: Sets the default visual report range used for rendered beacon range-report artifacts.

ground_truth.description: When true, publishes ground-truth beacon range reports in addition to noisy simulated reports when random noise is enabled.

node_pull_dist.description: Sets a vehicle-specific pull distance for vehicle-to-beacon range requests, overriding the default node pull distance for that vehicle.

node_push_dist.description: Sets a vehicle-specific push distance for beacon range reports, overriding the default node push distance for that vehicle.

ping_payments.description: Controls when a vehicle ping consumes its ping-wait interval. Supported modes include upon_request, upon_accept, and upon_response.

reach_distance.description: Sets a default or vehicle-specific range distance used when deciding whether beacon reports can be received.

report_vars.description: Selects which beacon range report variable style is posted. Supported values are short, long, and both.

verbose.description: Enables verbose terminal status output from uFldBeaconRangeSensor.

ignore_group.description: Ignores incoming node reports from contacts whose group matches this configured group.

ping_wait.description: Sets the minimum number of seconds enforced between range-sensor pings.

display_pulses.description: Controls whether simulated contact-range pings are rendered as visual pulse messages.

ground_truth.description: When true, publishes ground-truth range reports with noise removed alongside normal simulated range reports for diagnostics.

pull_dist.description: Sets a contact-specific pull distance used by the range sensor when evaluating whether a contact can be sensed or reported.

pull_distance.description: Sets a contact-specific pull distance used by the range sensor when evaluating whether a contact can be sensed or reported.

push_dist.description: Sets a contact-specific push distance used by the range sensor when evaluating whether a contact can be sensed or reported.

push_distance.description: Sets a contact-specific push distance used by the range sensor when evaluating whether a contact can be sensed or reported.

rn_gaussian_sigma.description: Sets the sigma value used when Gaussian random noise is applied to simulated range measurements.

sensor_arc.description: Adds an angular sensor field-of-view arc relative to vehicle heading. Multiple arcs may be configured; 360 gives full-circle coverage.

allow_echo_types.description: Restricts simulated range replies to contacts whose platform type is in the configured list. If no types are configured, all platform types are honored.

ground_true.description: Documentation spelling for ground_truth. When true, publishes ground-truth range reports with noise removed for diagnostics.

ping_color.description: Sets the visual color used for initiating range-request pulses.

reach_distance.description: Sets the distance out to which the pinging vehicle can be heard. The value may be numeric meters or nolimit.

reply_distance.description: Sets the distance out to which the pinged contact can reply. The value may be numeric meters or nolimit.

exponential_decay.description: Enables exponentially decaying detection probability beyond the combined reach and reply distances.

reply_color.description: Deprecated alias for echo_color. Sets the visual color used for reply/echo range pulses.

echo_color.description: Sets the visual color used for reply/echo range pulses.

report_vars.description: Selects which contact range report variable style is posted. Supported values are short, long, and both.

sensor_arcs.description: Adds angular sensor field-of-view arcs relative to vehicle heading. Multiple arcs may be configured; 360 gives full-circle coverage.

rn_algorithm.description: Selects the random-noise algorithm applied to simulated contact range measurements. An empty value means no random noise.

rn_uniform_pct.description: Sets the percent bound used by uniform random noise for simulated contact range measurements. Values are clipped to the range 0 to 1.

max_appcast_events.description: Limits how many appcast events uFldContactRangeSensor retains in diagnostic report history.

appcast_trunc_msg.description: Sets the maximum number of message characters shown per line in the appcast report.

aux_info.description: Controls the source auxiliary field attached to handled messages, such as node or node+app.

strict_addressing.description: When true, handles only messages whose destination node matches the local community; broad group or all-node messages are rejected.

msg_flag.description: Defines a MOOS variable-value post made when a valid incoming message is accepted and posted to the local MOOSDB.

bad_msg_flag.description: Defines a MOOS variable-value post made when an incoming message is validly formed but rejected by the handler.

bridge.description: Registers a MOOS variable with pShare for bridging to the shoreside MOOS community after a shore connection is established.

try_shore_host.description: Adds a candidate pShare input route used for initial pings while trying to establish a shoreside connection.

keyword.description: Defines a keyword included in brokered node communications when keyword matching is required by the shore broker.

auto_bridge_appcast.description: Controls whether uFldNodeBroker automatically bridges APPCAST traffic to support appcasting. Set false to opt out of the automatic bridge.

auto_bridge_realmcast.description: Controls whether uFldNodeBroker automatically bridges REALMCAST and REALMCAST_CHANNELS traffic to support realmcasting. Set false to opt out.

ignore_group.description: Ignores incoming node reports from contacts whose group matches this configured group.

stealth.description: Reduces how far this vehicle can be heard by other vehicles when sharing node reports. Values are in the range 0 to 1.

earange.description: Extends the range at which this vehicle can hear node reports from other vehicles. Values are in the range 1 to 10, with 1 as the default range multiplier.

comms_range.description: Sets the maximum range, in meters, for sharing inter-vehicle node reports and node messages. The value nolimit disables range cutoff.

critical_range.description: Sets the range within which node reports are shared for safety even when normal group or range rules would block them.

debug.description: Enables extra terminal debugging output from uFldNodeComms.

groups.description: When true, shares inter-vehicle node reports only between vehicles in the same group, except within the critical range.

min_msg_interval.description: Sets the minimum time, in seconds, between node-message sends from any one source vehicle.

max_msg_length.description: Sets the maximum number of characters allowed in the string component of an inter-vehicle node message.

min_rpt_interval.description: Sets the minimum time, in seconds, between node-report sends from any one source vehicle. A negative value disables report dropping.

msg_groups.description: When true, shares inter-vehicle node messages only between vehicles in the same group.

msg_color.description: Sets the color used for inter-vehicle message communication pulses.

msg_repeat_color.description: Sets the color used for communication pulses representing repeated previously dropped node messages.

pulse_duration.description: Sets how long communication pulses remain visible in viewers such as pMarineViewer.

shared_node_reports.description: When true, reposts shared node reports to the shoreside community as NODE_REPORT_UNC.

stale_time.description: Sets how long a vehicle may go without a fresh node report before it is considered stale and no longer eligible to receive reports or messages.

verbose.description: Enables verbose terminal status output from uFldNodeComms.

view_node_rpt_pulses.description: Controls whether uFldNodeComms posts visual communication pulses for successfully shared node reports.

drop_percentage.description: Sets the percentage of node messages randomly dropped to simulate lossy communications.

region.description: Defines the convex polygon region within which random or regenerated obstacles are placed.

match_group.description: Restricts obstacle simulation or Voronoi processing to vessels matching this group name.

use_unc_reports.description: Uses NODE_REPORT_UNC rather than NODE_REPORT as the vehicle-report source, useful when simulating stale or delayed contact information.

load_summary.description: Names the MOOS variable where uFldObstacleSim posts a summary of loaded obstacle information.

scope.description: Adds a variable or field description to the uFldScope main report along with source information.

layout.description: Defines an alternate report table layout by selecting which fields are shown in each uFldScope row.

bridge.description: Names a local MOOS variable and optional alias to bridge from the shore community to vehicle communities.

keyword.description: Requires incoming NODE_BROKER_PING messages to contain this keyword before uFldShoreBroker responds.

qbridge.description: Adds shorthand bridge rules for both variable_$V and variable_ALL forms to vehicle communities.

try_vnode.description: Adds a candidate vehicle-node route for shore broker connection attempts.

auto_bridg_mhash.description: Legacy misspelled source-discovered alias for automatic MISSION_HASH bridging. Prefer auto_bridge_mhash when possible.

auto_bridge_appcast.description: Controls whether uFldShoreBroker automatically bridges APPCAST_REQ traffic to support appcasting. Set false to opt out of the automatic bridge.

auto_bridge_mhash.description: Controls whether uFldShoreBroker automatically bridges MISSION_HASH traffic. Set false to opt out of the automatic bridge.

auto_bridge_realmcast.description: Controls whether uFldShoreBroker automatically bridges REALMCAST_REQ traffic to support realmcasting. Set false to opt out of the automatic bridge.

warning_on_stale.description: When true, posts a warning if a previously known node has not been heard from for more than the stale-node interval.

breach_trigger.description: Sets how many load-gap threshold breaches are tolerated before uLoadWatch posts a warning. A value of 1 warns on the first breach.

near_breach_thresh.description: Sets the fractional point between normal load and the configured breach threshold where uLoadWatch begins reporting near-breaches. For example, 0.9 reports when the gap reaches 90% of the way to the breach threshold.

thresh.description: Defines an app-specific or catch-all load-gap threshold using fields such as app and gapthresh. When the measured app iteration gap exceeds this multiplier, uLoadWatch can post a load warning.

appcast_height.description: Sets the height of the appcast display pane in uMACView.

infocast_height.description: Sets the height of the infocast display pane. Supported values are 30 through 90 in increments of 5.

realmcast_channel.description: Selects which realmcast channel uMACView displays on startup.

realmcast_show_communinity.description: Legacy misspelled alias for realmcast_show_community. Controls whether the Community column is shown in realmcast output.

watch_cluster.description: Selects the initial appcast or realmcast cluster watched by uMACView.

finish_val.description: Sets the value that must be observed on finish_var before uMayFinish allows completion.

max_db_uptime.description: Sets the MOOSDB uptime, in seconds, after which uMayFinish exits regardless of finish_var state. A negative value disables this timeout.

finish_var.description: Names the MOOS variable uMayFinish monitors to decide whether the mission may finish.

nowatch.description: Names process patterns that uProcessWatch should ignore even if they appear in DB_CLIENTS or the Antler-launched process list.

summary_wait.description: Sets the maximum time between PROC_WATCH_SUMMARY postings. A negative value posts summaries only when watched process status changes.

watch.description: Names a process that uProcessWatch should monitor and report as running or missing. Optional mappings may associate a watched process with a status variable.

allow_retractions.description: Controls whether uProcessWatch retracts run warnings when a missing process reappears. true always allows retraction, false disables it, and a numeric value limits retraction to that many seconds.

post_mapping.description: Maps one uProcessWatch posting variable to another output variable name.

watch_all.description: Controls whether uProcessWatch automatically monitors processes discovered from DB_CLIENTS and the Antler launch list.

compressalogs.description: Compresses generated alog files after logging completes when compression support is available.

doubleprecision.description: Sets how many digits pLogger writes for double-valued entries in alog output.

log.description: Adds a MOOS variable to pLogger synchronous logging output.

logauxsrc.description: Includes MOOS auxiliary source information in asynchronous log entries when available.

utclogdirectories.description: Uses UTC time when naming pLogger log directories.

wildcardexclusionlog.description: Writes wildcard-rejected variables to a separate exclusion log instead of silently omitting them.

wildcardomitpattern.description: Adds a wildcard pattern for MOOS variables that pLogger should omit from wildcard logging.

synclog.description: Controls synchronous logging. The value may include a boolean enable flag and an optional period.

marker_shape.description: Sets the shape used when rendering map markers.

show_markers.description: Controls whether map markers themselves are rendered.

show_mlabels.description: Controls whether map-marker labels are rendered.

show_mlables.description: Misspelled source-discovered alias for show_mlabels. Prefer show_mlabels in new mission files.

bin_min_val.description: Sets the minimum value included in collision/obstacle detection histogram bins. A negative value disables the lower cutoff.

sensor_config.description: Defines one simulated generic sensor, including its label and reporting behavior.

behaviors_consise.description: Legacy misspelled alias for behaviors_concise. Controls whether idle and completed behaviors are reported compactly.

truncated_output.description: Truncates the MOOS-scope or behavior-scope sections of uHelmScope output to fit compact terminal displays.

mission_hash_var.description: Names the MOOS variable where pMissionHash posts the full mission hash. Set this to off to disable full-hash posting.

mhash_short_var.description: Names the MOOS variable where pMissionHash posts the short mission hash. The local source initializes this to MHASH; setting it to off disables the short-hash post.

history.description: Sets how many recent node records uFldPathCheck keeps for each vehicle when estimating present speed and checking path progress.

app_logging.description: Enables app-level AppCasting logging for the current MOOS app. This records diagnostic app output and does not change the app-specific mission behavior.

max_appcast_events.description: Limits how many appcast events the current MOOS app retains in its diagnostic report history.

draw_save_statue.description: Source-discovered misspelling of draw_save_status. It controls whether the save-status polygon visualization is drawn while the behavior is recovering toward the save polygon.

p1.description: Sets one endpoint of the primary leg-run track line in local x,y coordinates.

p2.description: Sets the other endpoint of the primary leg-run track line in local x,y coordinates.

leg.description: Defines the primary leg-run track line by center point, angle, and length rather than by explicit p1 and p2 endpoints.

leg_len.description: Sets a new length for the primary leg-run track while preserving its center and angle. The behavior recalculates both endpoints from the new length.

leg_length.description: Source-level spelling for setting the length of the primary leg-run track while preserving its center and angle.

leg_len_mod.description: Adds a runtime adjustment to the current primary-leg length while preserving the leg center and angle. The resulting length is bounded by leg_len_min.

leg_length_mod.description: Source-level spelling for adding a runtime adjustment to the current primary-leg length.

leg_len_min.description: Sets the minimum allowed leg length when leg length is modified dynamically. The behavior enforces a lower safety bound on this value.

leg_ang.description: Sets a new angle for the primary leg-run track while preserving its center and length.

leg_ang_mod.description: Adds a runtime adjustment to the current primary-leg angle while preserving the leg center and length.

full_leg.description: Requires the vehicle to complete the full configured leg before transitioning into turn behavior.

init_leg_mode.description: Selects the initial leg/turn mode used when the behavior starts. Use this when startup should force a particular first leg direction or mode.

lr_mode.description: Runtime status value indicating the current leg-run phase, such as leg1, leg2, turn1, or turn2. This is normally reported by the behavior, not configured by users.

lr_mode_report.description: Runtime coordination report containing the current leg-run mode, vehicle name, and timestamp for multi-vehicle coordination.

lr_os_degs.description: Runtime coordination value giving ownship position in degrees on the reference circle used by multi-vehicle leg-run coordination.

shift_pt.description: Moves the primary leg so its center is at the given x,y point while preserving the original leg length and angle.

shift_point.description: Source-level spelling for shifting the primary leg so its center is at the given x,y point while preserving length and angle.

variable.description: Runtime coordination field used by BHV_LegRun status reporting. It is not a primary user-facing mission tuning parameter.

vx1.description: Source-level coordinate for the x value of the first leg-run vertex.

vx2.description: Source-level coordinate for the x value of the second leg-run vertex.

fierce_zigging.description: Requests the zig leg with a direct relative-heading command rather than the gentler default zig behavior.

max_zig_legs.description: Sets how many zig legs must be completed before the behavior can complete.

max_zig_zags.description: Sets the maximum number of complete zig-zag cycles before the behavior can complete.

max_stem_odo.description: Sets the maximum distance traveled along the stem line before the behavior completes. A negative value disables this completion criterion.

zig_angle.description: Sets the relative angle used for the ordinary zig leg.

zig_angle_fierce.description: Sets the relative heading request used when fierce_zigging is enabled.

zig_first.description: Selects which side is used for the first zig. Supported values include port and starboard/star.

center_assign.description: Moves the loiter polygon center to the given x,y point during configuration or updates.

xcenter_assign.description: Moves only the x-coordinate of the loiter polygon center, preserving the current y-coordinate.

ycenter_assign.description: Moves only the y-coordinate of the loiter polygon center, preserving the current x-coordinate.

post_suffix.description: Adds a suffix to MOOS variables posted by this loiter behavior so multiple loiter instances can be distinguished.

slingshot.description: Enables loiter slingshot handling when approaching the polygon. A negative value leaves this handling disabled.

compression.description: Compresses the ideal convoy range and speed policy so the follower can close distance more aggressively.

tail_length_max.description: Sets the maximum marker tail length retained for convoy visualization before older tail markers are dropped.

rng_estop.description: Sets the convoy emergency-stop range. When the follower is too close, the behavior can drive toward stopping.

rng_lagging.description: Sets the convoy range beyond which the follower is considered lagging behind the contact.

rng_tgating.description: Sets the convoy tailgating range where the follower is considered too close but not necessarily in emergency stop.

peakwidth.description: Sets the width, in meters per second, of the peak region in the speed utility function.

summitdelta.description: Sets the summit delta used in the ZAIC-style speed objective function.

period_busy.description: Sets the duration, in seconds, of the busy/high-speed portion of the periodic speed cycle.

period_lazy.description: Sets the duration, in seconds, of the lazy/low-speed portion of the periodic speed cycle.

ascent_grade.description: Controls how desired speed is reduced during ascent toward the surface. The default linear grade approaches zero speed steadily.

period.description: Sets the duration, in seconds, of the waiting interval before the behavior next requests surfacing.

BHV_Trail.reviewSource: MOOS-IvP bhv_trail.pdf and IvP contact behavior source

trail_angle.description: Sets the relative angle behind or around the contact used to place the trail point.

n_alert_request.description: Suppresses or controls the automatic contact-manager alert request normally used by contact behaviors.

efficiency_measure.description: Enables or disables leg-by-leg waypoint efficiency measurement and reporting.

order.description: Sets the order in which waypoints are traversed. Supported values include normal, reverse, and toggle.

greedy_tour.description: Allows waypoint ordering to be optimized greedily before traversal.

reset_on_idle.description: Resets waypoint progress when the behavior becomes idle.

shortest_tour.description: Requests shortest-tour ordering of the waypoint set before traversal.

eval_tol.description: Sets the tolerance used when evaluating candidate COLREGS maneuvers.

passing_side.description: Selects which side the COLREGS passing maneuver is evaluated or preferred on.

post_status_info_on_idle.description: Keeps posting COLREGS status information even while the behavior is idle.

velocity_filter.description: Applies a velocity-based contact filter before evaluating COLREGS maneuvers.

cnh.description: Sets the contact heading used by the avoidance geometry calculations.

cnv.description: Sets the contact speed used by the avoidance geometry calculations.

refine_piece.description: Enables objective-function piece refinement for the collision-avoidance utility surface.

roc_max_dampen.description: Limits how much rate-of-closure can dampen collision-avoidance utility.

roc_max_heighten.description: Limits how much rate-of-closure can heighten collision-avoidance utility.

action.description: Selects the requested obstacle action, such as enabling, disabling, or otherwise changing a matching obstacle.

obid.description: Matches an obstacle by obstacle id for the requested obstacle action.

obstacle_key.description: Matches an obstacle by obstacle key for the requested obstacle action.

vsource.description: Matches an obstacle by visualization/source identifier for the requested obstacle action.

max_window_utility.description: Sets the maximum utility assigned inside the hysteresis window.

bearing_line*.description: Configures bearing-line visualization between ownship and a contact. The color thresholds map either relevance or range values to line colors, and related boolean parameters control whether the line and its label are shown.

match_*.description: Adds a contact filter that requires the contact to match the named field before the behavior treats it as a valid contact.

ignore_*.description: Adds a contact filter that excludes contacts matching the named field before the behavior treats them as valid contacts.

nostarve.description: Requires one or more MOOS variables to stay fresh for the behavior to remain runnable. The value is a comma-separated list of variable names followed by the maximum allowed age in seconds.

no_starve.description: Alias of nostarve. It requires one or more MOOS variables to stay fresh for the behavior to remain runnable, with the final comma-separated value giving the allowed age in seconds.

bearing_lines.description: Configures contact bearing-line visualization as color:threshold pairs, optionally including info=range or info=relevance. When valid thresholds are provided, bearing-line drawing is enabled.

bearing_line_config.description: Configures contact bearing-line visualization as color:threshold pairs, optionally including info=range or info=relevance. This is the source-level spelling accepted by IvP contact behaviors.

bearing_line_show.description: Turns contact bearing-line drawing on or off when the behavior supports bearing-line visualization.

bearing_line_label_show.description: Controls whether labels are shown on contact bearing-line visualizations.

match_group.description: Requires the contact group to match the configured group before the behavior treats the contact as valid.

match_name.description: Requires the contact name to match the configured name before the behavior treats the contact as valid.

match_region.description: Requires the contact to be inside the configured convex region before the behavior treats the contact as valid.

match_type.description: Requires the contact type to match the configured type before the behavior treats the contact as valid.

ignore_group.description: Excludes contacts in the configured group before the behavior treats them as valid.

ignore_name.description: Excludes contacts with the configured name before the behavior treats them as valid.

ignore_region.description: Excludes contacts inside the configured convex region before the behavior treats them as valid.

ignore_type.description: Excludes contacts with the configured type before the behavior treats them as valid.

parameter.description: Documentation table placeholder, not an ordinary behavior configuration parameter. Prefer the specific OpRegion parameters such as core_poly, save_poly, halt_poly, max_depth, min_altitude, and reset.

core_poly.description: Defines the nominal operating area as a convex polygon. OpRegion behaviors use this as the primary region for containment and for deriving save/halt regions when distance offsets are configured.

save_poly.description: Defines the soft recovery polygon. When the vehicle exits this polygon, the behavior may produce an IvP function to guide it back inside before a harder halt breach occurs.

halt_poly.description: Defines the hard containment polygon. When the vehicle exits this polygon, the behavior signals a halt/all-stop style polygon breach.

max_depth.description: Sets the maximum allowable ownship depth in meters. A non-positive value leaves the depth limit disabled.

min_altitude.description: Sets the minimum allowable ownship altitude above the bottom in meters. A non-positive value leaves the altitude limit disabled.

reset.description: Resets a previously breached OpRegion condition back to its launch-like monitoring state. This is most useful when sent through the behavior updates variable during a mission.
